title: Observation Metric Sample
$comment: Repository-authoritative implementation schema (ticket #50, SPEC-302 section 14). Deliberately differs from the read-only spec-package draft schemas/metric-sample.schema.json: (a) FOUR fields ADDED per the approved seam ruling #12 and SPEC-300 section 6 / SPEC-302 section 6.2 — time.clock_epoch, time.semantics (record-level timepoints carry explicit semantics; the ENVELOPE timepoint intentionally does not, SPEC-301 section 6), top-level revision, top-level is_final ('样本 schema 的 revision/is_final 字段与本条款一一对应', SPEC-302 section 6.2); (b) value_type moved OUT of required — SPEC-302 section 3 lists the sample fields (指标名/时间戳/值/维度/来源/质量/revision/is_final) and value_type belongs to the metric DEFINITION, not the sample; the query response's series metadata carries it (SPEC-302 section 8). The spec-package draft is NOT edited in place (docs/spec README rule 2); this document is the implementation registry entry and the divergences are declared in the ticket #50 implementation report (brief section 8 G1). The quality enum is the SPEC-302 derived-series vocabulary (good/missing/late/estimated/partial/revised/invalid) — a DIFFERENT axis from the SPEC-003 section 2.5 logical MetricQuality (G10).
